title: Lost Mary BM600 Peach Ice Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: The Peach Ice Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pods deliver the juicy sweetness of ripe Peach lifted by a brisk icy note. This pairing balances smooth fruit flavour with a refreshing edge, ideal for all-day enjoyment. Each pack contains two 2ml pods prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, offering up to 600 puffs per pod depending on use. Their smooth mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw provides consistent satisfaction without the need for refills or coil changes. Made for the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit, installation is quick and mess-free: just click a pod into place and enjoy clean flavour and vapour production.
